Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We can confirm that the binding volume is our full demand for this part over the term, placed entirely with Nordmark. We appreciate the pressure from rising copper costs; rather than a fixed price, we propose an index clause with a deadband on your main cost driver, sharing the material risk while reflecting that in the price basis. Would this approach work for you?

We confirm a binding volume of 6110 units a year for the 12-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

On this basis we propose: EUR 344.50 per unit, payment 90 days net, price follows CU-NOTATION on 20% of the price, deadband 5%, for our full demand of 6110 units a year over 12 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €351.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION.
Please note:
We acknowledge your confirmation of the binding volume and agree to implement the CU-NOTATION index clause to manage material risk.
We are prepared to accept the extended payment terms of 90 days net as requested.
To accommodate these terms, we propose a unit price of EUR 351.90.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
